endButton: Give GANBARI Power Token to Sawtelle Spirit

dialogues.speaker: sachi
dialogues.text: SACHI: Yes, it is. After the war, many Japanese Americans returned here with nothing.

dialogues.speaker: sachi
dialogues.text: Mr. Riichi Ishioka opened this boarding house so they could start over.

dialogues.speaker: owner
dialogues.text: TOSH ISHIOKA: Hi Sachi and Sachi's friend. I'm Tosh, the son of Riichi Ishioka.

dialogues.speaker: sachi
dialogues.text: We saw a token glowing in your home. What does it mean?

dialogues.speaker: owner
dialogues.text: That is GANBARI. It means persistence.

dialogues.speaker: owner
dialogues.text: When we first came back from the war, people didn't want us here.

dialogues.speaker: owner
dialogues.text: Our house was even vandalized on the very first night.

dialogues.speaker: owner
dialogues.text: But we refused to give up. We worked, we built, and we stayed.

dialogues.speaker: player
dialogues.text: That must have taken so much courage.

dialogues.speaker: owner
dialogues.text: Yes, we had to GANBARI because persistence was the only way forward.

dialogues.speaker: owner
dialogues.text: Please take this token as a reminder of GANBARI (Persistence).
